name: io.github.amineutron/catt-mcp
title: Chromecast / DLNA casting (catt)
description: Cast YouTube videos and media to a Chromecast or DLNA device with catt, and control playback.

environmentVariables.name: CATT_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: Name or IP of the default Chromecast / DLNA device

environmentVariables.name: TV_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Optional Android TV IP, used to wake the screen over ADB before casting

environmentVariables.name: ADB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the adb binary if not on PATH
